clauses.clause: Whenever you gain life, each opponent loses 1 life.
clauses.evidence: [stimulus: you gain 3 life]: card's triggered ability [0] triggers; you gains 3 life; opp loses 1 life (by card/LOSE_LIFE); opp 20 -> 19, you 20 -> 23. The 'you' scope is not in the trace; pack epicure_of_blood_1 PASSES (the opponent's Dawning Angel gains them 4, Epicure does not trigger) and fails against a draft whose trigger reads the opponent's gain.
